$comment: Regression guard for FuzeFront#286: a branch-ruleset REQUIRED status check whose
producing workflow never runs — and so never reports — leaves the PR permanently
BLOCKED. GitHub treats a required-but-never-reported context as unsatisfied, so there
is no red to look at and nothing to re-run. #286 was the `paths:`-filter form of that
bug; it was fixed in #794 and `scripts/check-required-check-triggers.mjs` keeps it fixed.
Every entry names a `context` and the workflow file that produces it. The script
enforces two properties:
1. ALL entries: the workflow's `pull_request:` trigger carries no `paths:`/
`paths-ignore:` filter (the original #286 bug).
2. Entries with "requiredInRuleset": true — the workflow ALSO triggers on
`merge_group:`. A merge queue builds each candidate on a
`refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/...` branch and emits `merge_group`, never
`pull_request`. A required context whose workflow has no `merge_group` trigger is
therefore never created for a queue entry — #286 relocated into the queue, where
it strands the entry instead of the PR.
`requiredInRuleset` records whether ruleset 17974934 (live name 'Protect default
branch', verified 2026-10-26) currently lists the context under `required_status_checks`.
The eleven true entries below are exactly that live set. The four false entries are NOT
required today and are kept deliberately — their `pull_request:` path-filter protection
still applies, and dropping them would only shrink enforcement. Two of them,
`gate-frames-schema` and `gate-ds-artifact`, are STAGED FOR PROMOTION to the required set
(they are already in governance/required-status-checks.json's desired set): their
workflows now carry a `merge_group:` trigger PROACTIVELY, because both are sub-second and
dependency-free so running them on a queue entry costs nothing — flipping their
`requiredInRuleset` to true is then a pure listing with no workflow edit. The other two,
`gate-platform-org-pin` and `Playwright sign-in flow`, are left without `merge_group`
deliberately — adding it (notably e2e.yml's Playwright run) would burn runner time on
every queue entry to satisfy a context nothing gates on.
This file WAS stale: it listed six contexts, only two of which the ruleset required,
while nine required contexts were absent — so the guard covered 2 of 11. Its own rule
below is what went unfollowed as the required set grew from two to eleven.
Adding a NEW required context to the ruleset? Add its workflow here in the same PR,
with "requiredInRuleset": true — the gate is only as complete as this list. Flipping a
context's `requiredInRuleset` to true without giving its workflow a `merge_group`
trigger will fail this gate, by design.
